name: Sticky nightshade
desc: Red Buffalo-bur (Solanum sisymbriifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Solanum sisymbriifolium is commonly known as vila-vila, sticky nightshade, red buffalo-bur, the fire-and-ice plant, litchi tomato, or Morelle de Balbis.
